text:
sara: quick heads-up — plan to cut v2.14.0 tomorrow 09:00 PT. hard cutoff for merges is 08:30 PT. please confirm version bumps, changelog entries, and that CI artifacts land in S3 by 08:45 :hourglass_flowing_sand:

mike: on it. I have a PR to bump core package to 2.14.0, awaiting review from alex. changelog entry added under Unreleased -> v2.14.0 (short bullet).

alex: reviewing now, will approve in ~15m. small note: the SQL migration PR needs a backfill test, but it can be cherry-picked to release branch if needed.

priya: packaging the wheels and linux tarball. pushing artifacts to s3://redwood-releases/v2.14.0/tmp by EOD. will run checksum and upload final path once mike confirms tag.

sara: thanks. reminder to not force-push the release branch after cutoff. if you need an emergency fix, open a PR and tag me or josh.

release-bot: Release checklist status: CI: passing, Integration tests: running (6/8), SBOM generation: queued, Artifact upload: 0/3. ETA ~20m.

mike: FYI for tagging I'll create an annotated tag with the changelog blurb and the SHA we agree on. command I plan to run locally (share here for lockfile):
```
git tag -a v2.14.0 <commit-sha> -m "v2.14.0 — release notes: short changelog bullets"
gpg --detach-sign --armor v2.14.0
git push origin v2.14.0 && gh release create v2.14.0 --draft --notes-file ./release_notes.md
```

alex: looks good. for the GH draft, please attach these artifacts (exact filenames):
- redwood-core-2.14.0-py3-none-manylinux2014_x86_64.whl
- redwood-cli-2.14.0-linux.tar.gz
- docker-image-tag: redwood/inference:2.14.0 (published to ghcr)
and include checksums file: checksums-v2.14.0.txt (sha256).

priya: upload script I'm using, posting snippet:
```
aws s3 cp dist/ s3://redwood-releases/v2.14.0/ --recursive --acl private --exclude "*debug*"
sha256sum dist/* > checksums-v2.14.0.txt
aws s3 cp checksums-v2.14.0.txt s3://redwood-releases/v2.14.0/
```

josh: quick question — who will sign the tag? last time we used the release-key managed by ops. if ops isn't available I can sign with my key but will add the sig to the release notes.

sara: ops is on call tomorrow morning but we should plan to use the release-key. josh, please coordinate with @release-ops if you need fallback.

mike: after CI green I'll post the exact commit SHA here and create the annotated tag. then I will upload artifacts to the GH draft and ping @sara for final signoff.

release-bot: Integration tests complete: 8/8. SBOM generated. Artifact upload: 3/3. Checksums present.

priya: artifacts uploaded to final path s3://redwood-releases/v2.14.0/ and GHCR image pushed. I also uploaded the SBOM and checksums.

alex: approved the bump. mike — you have my ok to tag when ready.

mike: tagging now, creating annotated tag and pushing. will run gpg sign with ops key.

sara: great — once tag pushed, create GH draft, attach assets, mark it as draft, and we'll do a quick verification pass (verify checksums, smoke run). after my :thumbsup: we can publish.

josh: smoke run pass on main features. no regression observed locally.

mike: GH draft created: https://github.com/redwood/repo/releases/tag/v2.14.0 (draft). attached artifacts and notes. asking for final verifications from @alex @sara @priya.

sara: quick verification done, checksums match, smoke ok. publishing in 1m.

release-bot: Release v2.14.0 published by mike at 2165432199. Congratulations! :tada:

mike: published. thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. reminder: update the release board and close the release tracking ticket.

alex: adding post-release followups (monitoring alert thresholds, canary ramp) to the board.

priya: I'll start the cleanup of the tmp s3 path and tag the docker image 2.14 on prod registry.

sara: awesome work all. free to hop on a short retrospective call later today if we want to tighten anything in the flow. :rocket:
